title: Chapter 360 Encountering Jiang Mu Of Songjiang Gang
content:
Chapter 360 Encountering Jiang Mu Of Songjiang Gang

The second mine tunnel also reached the end not long after walking.

It took half an hour for the group to reach the end of the fifth mine tunnel.

It seemed that they had reached a passage connected to other mine tunnels.

Because the wood supporting the top of the tunnel along the way had different degrees of corrosion, and it was obviously from different eras.

In some places, there were traces of replacement, which should be because the previous wood was no longer usable, and later people replaced it for safety.

The mine tunnel was dark and damp, and water was dripping.

At this time, Wang Shuo faintly heard a strange sound.

But after listening carefully, it was gone.

Moreover, a large number of bones were found along the way, many of which were injured by weapons, and there should have been a battle.

Some people also picked up some weapons, armor and other items.

The group was not too surprised. After all, this kind of thing was too common for them.

Who can become a high-level general has countless lives in his hands.

After walking for another half an hour, the group still did not reach the end.

This strengthened everyone's confidence, and they felt that they had found the passage to the center of Chitong Mountain.

"What's ahead?"

At this time, someone was surprised.

Wang Shuo also looked ahead, and saw that at the end of the passage, there was a natural cave that could only accommodate one person crawling through.

Everyone looked at each other, and a brave man immediately said that he was willing to go in first to explore the way.

At this time, of course, no one would come out to object.

So the man named Ma Yu crawled in first.

The cave was very narrow, and Ma Yu crawled for more than ten minutes before passing through the passage.

After passing through the cave, it immediately became wider.

When he was sure that there was no danger for the time being, he shouted to the passage: "No problem."

Then the others rushed to pass through one by one.

Soon only Wang Shuo and Song Bo were left.

At this time, Wang Shuo became alert.

"Will Brother Wang go in first or we go in first?"

"You go in first."

Such a narrow passage, whether it is the first or the last, if the opponent attacks, it is quite dangerous.

At this time, there is no other way, because there is only such a passage.

Song Bo did not create an accident at this time.

Wang Shuo successfully reached the end of the passage.

Under the illumination of the firelight, the cave gradually opened up.

There were actually roots of some plants growing inside, which were intertwined and surprised Wang Shuo.

At this time, someone broke into another passage in the cave.

"Who?"

The other passage was obviously much larger than the one Wang Shuo and his team took, and they only needed to bend down to pass through.

Soon, dozens of people gathered on the opposite side.

No valuable things were found so far, and both sides were still very restrained.

At this time, the person in charge on the opposite side came over.

"I'm Jiang Mu from Songjiang Gang. Everyone, this place is a bit weird. Why don't we explore it together?"

Many people complained in their hearts: "There is only one passage left in front of us, leading to deeper depths. If we don't explore together, do we have to fight first?"

"If we don't see any benefits, we will just fight directly. Isn't it a waste of life?"

Wang Cuilian immediately said: "It turns out to be Deputy Gang Leader Jiang. You go first, and we can just follow behind and play soy sauce."

Just kidding, if I and others go to explore the way first and find good things, they will also be wrapped up.

If they encounter danger, they will become the pathfinder for others.

"It's beautiful to think about it. Do you want us to explore the way for you and you follow behind to pick up the leaks?"

At this time, someone on the other side said in a yin and yang tone.

"Bullshit!"

Both sides left the swords drawn and showed their weapons.

Wang Shuo also took the Blood-Crying Gun in his hand and quietly retreated to the edge of the stone wall.
